Container.Name: Aperture
Container.Overview: Aperture creates Jellyfin or Emby accounts from controlled invite links and applies non-admin policy templates.
Container.Requires: Complete browser setup on a trusted network before exposing Aperture publicly. Back up the entire appdata directory.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent database, configuration, and generated secrets.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Container user ID. Unraid's nobody user is 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Container group ID. Unraid's users group is 100.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional browser-facing Aperture URL. Leave empty to configure it during browser setup.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: Leave empty to infer from the public URL; otherwise set true for HTTPS or false for HTTP.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Comma-separated CIDRs that directly connect a trusted reverse proxy to Aperture.

Config.Name: Media Provider
Config.Description: Optional jellyfin or emby override. Leave empty for browser setup.

Config.Name: Media Server URL
Config.Description: Optional internal Jellyfin or Emby URL. Leave empty for browser setup.

Config.Name: Media Server API Key
Config.Description: Optional Jellyfin or Emby API key. Leave empty for browser setup.
